ja: お前[まえ]の**正体[しょうたい]**を見[み]せろ
en: Show your true form; 正 true plus 体 body so it is what hides under a disguise not merely a name

ja: **ライオン**みたいな魔物[まもの]だ
en: It is a lion-like monster; the katakana word is only the actual animal while classical or heraldic lions are 獅子

ja: 大[だい]**賢者[けんじゃ]**が答[こた]えた
en: The Great Sage answered; 賢 wise plus 者 person and 大賢者 is Rimuru's unique skill rather than any human teacher

ja: 今[いま]は**暇[ひま]**か
en: Are you free right now; it names both spare time and being idle so calling someone 暇な人 can sting

ja: 魔物[まもの]の**反応[はんのう]**がある
en: There is a monster reading; 反 counter plus 応 respond — used for sensor blips and chemical reactions as well as a person's response

ja: **長[なが]い**話[はなし]になるな
en: This is going to be a long story; length in space or in time whereas 遠い is distance away; 長い間 means a long while

ja: **どうせ**負[ま]けるだろう
en: We are going to lose anyway; resigned anyway where the speaker has already accepted the outcome so it lands cynical

ja: **まるで**子供[こども]みたいだ
en: He is just like a child; it sets up a simile and wants みたい or ような later in the sentence

ja: **大[たい]した**事[こと]ないよ
en: It is no big deal; it only sits before a noun and almost always ends negated — the rare positive 大したものだ is praise

ja: その**武器[ぶき]**を置[お]け
en: Put that weapon down; 武 martial plus 器 implement so it is the whole category that 剣 belongs to

ja: お前[まえ]は**偉[えら]い**な
en: You did well; praise for character or high rank and often said to children — 凄い instead reacts to an impressive feat

ja: 戦[たたか]いが**始[はじ]まる**
en: The battle is starting; the intransitive twin of 始める so the thing begins on its own and takes が never を

ja: あいつは**化[ば]け物[もの]**だ
en: That guy is a monster; from 化ける to shape-shift plus 物 — thrown in awe or insult at overwhelming strength unlike the neutral 魔物

ja: **嘘[うそ]**をつくなよ
en: Do not lie; the fixed collocation is 嘘をつく and a bare 嘘 shouted alone means no way

ja: **ポーション**を飲[の]め
en: Drink the potion; game loanword for a healing item and nothing to do with a portion of food; ordinary medicine is 薬

ja: 魔法[まほう]が**効[き]かない**
en: The magic is not working; the subject is the drug or attack rather than the person affected — 効果 is the noun and 聞く is the same sound

ja: **承知[しょうち]**しました
en: Understood; 承 receive plus 知 know — servant register for accepting an order where 分かりました is neutral

ja: いい**考[かんが]え**だな
en: That is a good idea; the noun of 考える meaning a worked-out plan or standpoint while 気持ち is how you feel

ja: 俺[おれ]が**始末[しまつ]**する
en: I will handle it; 始 start plus 末 end — seeing a mess through to its conclusion and of a person it means finish off

ja: 我[われ]と**敵対[てきたい]**するのか
en: Do you mean to oppose me; 敵 enemy plus 対 facing — taking a hostile stance which need not become 戦う actual fighting

ja: この店[みせ]で**売[う]って**いる
en: They sell it at this shop; the transitive partner of 買う while intransitive 売れる means it sells well

ja: **明日[あした]**町[まち]へ行[い]くぞ
en: We're heading into town tomorrow; 明日 is read あした in normal speech — あす is the stiff newscast reading and みょうにち is business letters

ja: 剣[けん]で**刺[さ]した**
en: I ran him through with my sword; 刺す is a point-first thrust that goes in — slashing with the edge is 切る

ja: 準備[じゅんび]**完了[かんりょう]**だ
en: Preparations complete; 完了 is the clipped report that a task reached its goal — 完成 is an object being finished and 終わる is mere stopping

ja: **仕方[しかた]ない**な
en: Nothing to be done about it; literally "there is no way of doing it" — pure resignation to circumstances and never an apology for your own choice

ja: みんな**笑[わら]って**いる
en: Everybody's laughing; 笑う covers grinning as well as laughing out loud so context decides which — laughing at someone takes を

ja: お名前[なまえ]は**存[ぞん]じて**おります
en: I do know your name; 存じる is humble 知る that lowers the speaker — the listener's knowing is ご存じ so never bend 存じる onto them

ja: **ただ**の人間[にんげん]だ
en: He's just an ordinary human; ただの before a noun downgrades it to "mere" — as an adverb ただ means only or simply

ja: **落[お]ち着[つ]け**お前[まえ]
en: Calm down; 落ち着く is settling of its own accord and the bark 落ち着け tells someone to stop panicking — 安心 is relief once the danger is gone

ja: 命令[めいれい]を**伝達[でんたつ]**しろ
en: Relay the order; 伝達 is passing a message down an official chain — 伝える is any casual telling

ja: **大[おお]きな**問題[もんだい]だ
en: That's a big problem; 大きな is a frozen form that only sits before a noun — it cannot end a sentence the way 大きい does

ja: ドワーフの**技術[ぎじゅつ]**は凄[すご]い
en: Dwarven craftsmanship is incredible; 技術 is skill plus method — the whole accumulated body of technique whereas 技 is one single move

ja: この**道[みち]**は危険[きけん]だ
en: This road is dangerous; 道 is a physical path but also the way of a discipline — a named city street is 通り

ja: それはお前[まえ]の**癖[くせ]**だな
en: That's a habit of yours; 癖 is an involuntary tic you barely notice and it leans negative — a deliberate good routine is 習慣

ja: 何[なに]か**文句[もんく]**があるのか
en: Got something to complain about?; 文句 is literally a phrase of words and as a complaint it means grumbling said out loud — a formal grievance is 苦情

ja: **苦労[くろう]**をかけたな
en: Sorry for putting you through that; 苦労 is drawn-out toil you endure — ご苦労 said downward to a subordinate can offend an equal

ja: それは**推測[すいそく]**に過[す]ぎない
en: That is nothing more than conjecture; 推測 is inferring from evidence you have — 想像 is free imagining with nothing to go on

ja: **どの**武器[ぶき]を使[つか]う
en: Which weapon will you use?; どの must be glued to a following noun — どれ stands alone and どちら politely picks between two

ja: お前[まえ]は**心[こころ]**が強[つよ]い
en: You have a strong heart; 心 is the seat of feeling and will — 気持ち is one passing feeling and 頭 is the intellect

ja: **国王[こくおう]**陛下[へいか]がお呼[よ]びだ
en: His Majesty the King summons you; 国王 is country plus king — the human sovereign of a nation as opposed to the 魔王 rank

ja: 少[すこ]し**相談[そうだん]**したい
en: I want to talk it over a bit; 相談 is two-way consultation aimed at a decision — 報告 flows one way upward

ja: **ゆっくり**話[はな]してくれ
en: Speak slowly for me; ゆっくり means unhurried in speed but also at ease — ゆっくりして is an invitation to relax and stay

ja: **ともかく**逃[に]げよう
en: Anyway let's get out of here; ともかく shelves the argument to deal with what matters now — it also means "setting X aside"

ja: 調査[ちょうさ]**終了[しゅうりょう]**だ
en: Survey over; 終了 announces the scheduled end of an activity — 完了 stresses the aim was achieved and 終わり is the plain noun

ja: その**提案[ていあん]**を受[う]けよう
en: Let us take that proposal; 提案 is present plus plan — something formally put on the table for others to weigh

ja: 力[ちから]を**奪[うば]われた**
en: My power was stolen from me; 奪う wrenches something away from an unwilling owner — 取る is neutral picking up

ja: 敵[てき]が**消[き]えた**
en: The enemy vanished; 消える happens by itself with nothing acting on it — 消す is the transitive twin for putting out a light or erasing

ja: **村長[そんちょう]**に会[あ]いたい
en: I'd like to see the village chief; 村長 is village plus chief read そんちょう — an elected local head not a 首領 gang boss

ja: **許可[きょか]**をもらった
en: I got permission; 許可 is sanction granted by an authority — 許す is a person personally letting something slide

ja: **きっと**勝[か]てる
en: We can definitely win; きっと is the speaker's own conviction rather than proven fact — 絶対 is flatter and more forceful

ja: お前[まえ]は**何者[なにもの]**だ
en: Just what are you?; 何者 demands what kind of being someone is — 誰 merely asks for a name

ja: 軍[ぐん]に**蹂躙[じゅうりん]された**
en: We were overrun by their army; 蹂躙 is trampling underfoot — a heavy literary word for a place being violated wholesale

ja: 商人[しょうにん]が**金貨[きんか]**をくれた
en: The merchant gave me gold coins; 金貨 is gold plus coin — minted currency you count in 枚 not a lump of the metal itself

ja: いい**夢[ゆめ]**を見[み]た
en: I had a good dream; 夢 spans sleeping dreams and life ambitions — the verb is always 夢を見る never 夢をする

ja: 子供[こども]が**眠[ねむ]って**いる
en: The kid's fast asleep; 眠る is the state of being asleep — 寝る is going to bed and lying down

ja: 結界[けっかい]が**消滅[しょうめつ]した**
en: The barrier was annihilated; 消滅 is being wiped out of existence for good — 消える can be a thing merely going out of sight

ja: **様子[ようす]**を見[み]てくれ
en: Go see how things look; 様子 is the visible appearance of a scene or person — 状況 is the situation stated abstractly

ja: **各国[かっこく]**が動[うご]き出[だ]した
en: The nations have started moving; 各国 is each plus country taken one by one — 国家 is the state as an institution

ja: 村[むら]が**襲[おそ]われた**
en: The village was raided; 襲う is a sudden descent on a place or person — 攻撃 is a blow struck in ongoing combat

ja: 仲間[なかま]を**失[うしな]った**
en: I lost a comrade; 失う is losing something weighty and unrecoverable — misplacing your keys is なくす

ja: あいつは**成長[せいちょう]**したな
en: He has really grown; 成長 is natural developmental growth over time — 進化 is the abrupt system-granted evolution of this show

ja: **いかが**なさいますか
en: What would you like to do?; いかが is the polite どう and shows up when offering something or asking a superior's wishes

ja: 商人[しょうにん]からの**依頼[いらい]**だ
en: It's a commission from a merchant; 依頼 is a formal job request with an expectation of payment — 頼む is the everyday verb of asking

ja: 私[わたし]が**出向[でむ]く**
en: I'll go there in person; 出向く is going out to where the other party is and implies you're the one making the effort — 行く says nothing about that

ja: **姫[ひめ]**を守[まも]れ
en: Protect the princess; 姫 is a highborn daughter and works as a title stuck after her name — 王女 is the flat term for a king's daughter

ja: 手[て]**加減[かげん]**はしないぞ
en: I am not holding back; 加減 is add plus subtract so it is dialing a degree up or down — 手加減 is easing off in a fight and いい加減 is a sloppy half-measure

ja: あいつは**脅威[きょうい]**だ
en: That guy is a threat; 脅威 is the looming menace a power poses to you — 危険 just labels something dangerous

ja: これで**終[お]わり**だ
en: That's the end of it; 終わり is the noun off 終わる and announces something is over — 最後 is the final item in a lineup

ja: お前[まえ]**以外[いがい]**にいない
en: There's nobody but you; 以外 excludes whatever precedes it — do not mix it up with the homophone 意外 meaning unexpected

ja: 迷宮[めいきゅう]の**管理[かんり]**は俺[おれ]だ
en: The labyrinth is under my management; 管理 is ongoing administrative upkeep of a system — 支配 is domination over it

ja: お前[まえ]の**判断[はんだん]**に任[まか]せる
en: I leave the call to you; 判断 is weighing the facts to a conclusion — 決める is the act of settling on one option

ja: 声[こえ]が**聞[き]こえる**
en: I can hear a voice; the intransitive pair of 聞[き]く: the sound reaches you whether you listen or not

ja: 剣[けん]が**落[お]ちた**
en: the sword fell; covers dropping and also failing a test or a fortress falling to an enemy

ja: お前[まえ]**しゃべる**な
en: shut your mouth; casual chatting rather than 話[はな]す which can be a serious discussion

ja: **牢獄[ろうごく]**に入[い]れろ
en: throw him in the dungeon; a stone cell for prisoners; unlike 迷宮[めいきゅう] which is the monster labyrinth

ja: それが**ギルド**の仕事[しごと]だ
en: that is the guild's job; in the show the adventurer and merchant guilds license and dispatch work

ja: 攻撃[こうげき]を**食[く]らった**
en: I took the hit; same verb as eating but here used for receiving damage or a scolding

ja: **全部[ぜんぶ]**俺[おれ]がやる
en: I'll do all of it; concrete and countable while 全[すべ]て is more abstract and formal

ja: 作戦[さくせん]が**決[き]まった**
en: the plan is settled; it got decided on its own; versus 決[き]める where someone decides it

ja: 俺[おれ]たちは**兄弟[きょうだい]**だ
en: we are brothers; literally elder brother plus younger brother and used for siblings of any mix

ja: お前[まえ]の**思[おも]い**は分[わ]かった
en: I understand how you feel; the noun leans emotional attachment while 考[かんが]え is a reasoned opinion

ja: **昔[むかし]**の話[はなし]だ
en: that's an old story; a vague distant past rather than a datable point in time

ja: まずは**挨拶[あいさつ]**だな
en: greetings first; covers bowing and formal opening remarks; 挨拶[あいさつ]する is the whole social ritual

ja: 仲間[なかま]が**大事[だいじ]**なんだ
en: my comrades matter to me; 大事[だいじ] stresses you value it while 重要[じゅうよう] is objective importance

ja: **厄介[やっかい]**な相手[あいて]だ
en: he's a nasty opponent; the trouble is the burden of dealing with it; 危険[きけん] is about danger instead

ja: **戦闘[せんとう]**の準備[じゅんび]をしろ
en: prepare for combat; one engagement; 戦争[せんそう] is the whole war and 戦[たたか]い the fight in general

ja: **会議[かいぎ]**を始[はじ]めよう
en: let's begin the meeting; a seated formal session; the show uses it for the demon lords' council

ja: 俺[おれ]の**娘[むすめ]**に手[て]を出[だ]すな
en: keep your hands off my daughter; 娘 is your own daughter or any young woman; someone else's daughter is 娘さん and お嬢さん is the polite address

ja: 説明[せつめい]が**難[むずか]しい**
en: the explanation is hard to follow; hard to grasp or handle; 大変[たいへん] is hard as in laborious

ja: **向[む]こう**に町[まち]がある
en: there's a town over there; the far side away from the speaker and also the other party in talks

ja: **女王[じょおう]**の前[まえ]に立[た]つ
en: I stand before the queen; a queen ruling in her own right and not the king's wife

ja: **噂[うわさ]**は本当[ほんとう]だった
en: the rumor was true; neutral hearsay in Japanese and 噂[うわさ]をする is simply gossiping about someone

ja: **家[いえ]**に帰[かえ]るぞ
en: we're going home; 家 is the building and also the family line; うち is your own home as the place you belong and 家庭 is the household as a unit

ja: お前[まえ]**結構[けっこう]**強[つよ]いな
en: you're pretty strong actually; adverb for a surprising amount; alone as 結構[けっこう]です it politely declines

ja: 腕[うで]が**再生[さいせい]**した
en: my arm regenerated; literally again plus live and in the show the slime's healing skill

ja: みんな**喜[よろこ]ぶ**ぞ
en: everyone will be thrilled; a visible outward reaction; 楽[たの]しむ is enjoying an activity

ja: **無限[むげん]**に増[ま]すのか
en: does it increase without limit; literally no plus limit and a favorite prefix for skill names

ja: **最近[さいきん]**眠[ねむ]れない
en: I haven't slept lately; a stretch of recent days; さっき is minutes ago

ja: **兵士[へいし]**を連[つ]れて行[い]く
en: I'll take soldiers along; a rank and file trooper unlike 騎士[きし] the knight or 戦士[せんし] the warrior

ja: **しかも**敵[てき]は多[おお]い
en: and on top of that there are many enemies; piles another point onto the previous one and usually a worse one

ja: 俺[おれ]が**代[か]わり**に戦[たたか]う
en: I'll fight in his place; 代[か]わりに means instead of; the noun is the stand in itself

ja: **客[きゃく]**が来[き]たぞ
en: we've got a visitor; one word for guest and paying customer so context decides

ja: **疲[つか]れ**が残[のこ]ってる
en: the fatigue is still with me; noun form of 疲[つか]れる treated as a thing that accumulates and lingers

ja: **勝利[しょうり]**は我々[われわれ]の物[もの]だ
en: victory is ours; the formal noun for a won battle; 勝[か]ち is the everyday word

ja: **秘書[ひしょ]**に任[まか]せる
en: leave it to my secretary; literally secret plus writer; a trusted aide who handles a lord's affairs

ja: 俺[おれ]と**勝負[しょうぶ]**しろ
en: fight me; win plus lose so it is a match with a decided outcome not just combat

ja: その**罪[つみ]**は許[ゆる]さない
en: I won't forgive that crime; covers legal crime and moral sin; 罪[つみ]がない means innocent

ja: **必[かなら]ず**帰[かえ]ってくる
en: I will come back without fail; a promise about the future; きっと is only your confident guess

ja: スキルで**鑑定[かんてい]**する
en: I'll appraise it with my skill; expert identification of an item's nature; 解析[かいせき] is taking apart how it works

ja: **諸国[しょこく]**に伝[つた]える
en: we'll inform the various nations; 諸 is a plural marker; 各国[かっこく] is each nation taken one by one

ja: まだ**余裕[よゆう]**がある
en: I've still got room to spare; spare capacity in time strength or nerve; 余裕[よゆう]がない means stretched thin

ja: 嘘[うそ]が**ばれた**
en: my lie got found out; the secret is the subject and the exposure just happens to you; casual speech only

ja: この国[くに]の**民[たみ]**を守[まも]る
en: I'll protect the people of this land; the governed populace seen from above; 住民[じゅうみん] is just residents

ja: 子供[こども]の**頃[ころ]**の夢[ゆめ]だ
en: it's my childhood dream; always attached to a modifier as around that time; never stands alone

ja: 妹[いもうと]を**探[さが]して**いる
en: I'm looking for my little sister; searching for something lost; 調[しら]べる is investigating a matter

ja: 新[あたら]しい技[わざ]を**試[ため]す**
en: I'll try out the new technique; testing to see how it performs; やってみる is merely giving it a go

ja: **糸[いと]**で罠[わな]を作[つく]る
en: I'll make a trap with thread; also the thread of fate or a clue; 糸[いと]を引[ひ]く is pulling strings

ja: **互[たが]い**に信[しん]じよう
en: let's trust each other; almost always as お互[たが]い or 互[たが]いに; the reciprocity is built into the word

ja: **仲良[なかよ]く**遊[あそ]べ
en: play nicely together; adverb from 仲[なか] the relationship plus good; 仲良[なかよ]くなる is becoming friends

ja: 命[いのち]は**大切[たいせつ]**だ
en: life is precious; emotional cherishing while 大事[だいじ] can also just mean practically important

ja: 本当[ほんとう]に**申[もう]し訳[わけ]**ない
en: I am terribly sorry; literally no excuse to offer and heavier than すみません — the full apology is 申し訳ありません

ja: **おいおい**待[ま]ってくれ
en: Hey hold on a second; Stretched-out おい — half protest half disbelief at what someone just said or did. Not a call for attention like a single おい

ja: **真[しん]**の魔王[まおう]だ
en: He is a true Demon Lord; Prefix 真の marks the genuine article as opposed to those merely called that. Read しん here; alone the kanji is まこと

ja: **旅[たび]**に出[で]るぞ
en: We are setting off on a journey; 旅 is travel as an experience with no fixed destination implied; a return trip with a purpose is 旅行 instead

ja: 計画[けいかく]を**立[た]てた**
en: We made a plan; Literally to stand something up — Japanese erects plans and strategies rather than making them. Transitive pair of 立つ

ja: 姫[ひめ]の**護衛[ごえい]**を頼[たの]む
en: Take charge of guarding the princess; 護衛 is "protect" + "defend" and means both the bodyguard duty and the person doing it. Escorting cargo is 護送

ja: **おら**は行[い]くぞ
en: I am going; Country-bumpkin form of 俺 — heavy rural accent. Putting it in a noble's mouth would sound absurd

ja: 力[ちから]が**暴走[ぼうそう]**する
en: His power is running wild; "Violence" + "run" — power or a vehicle careering out of the owner's control. Used of magic backfiring on its caster

ja: その説明[せつめい]で**納得[なっとく]**した
en: That explanation satisfied me; 納得 is accepting something as reasonable after doubting it; 理解 is merely grasping the content without agreeing

ja: **更[さら]に**強[つよ]くなった
en: He got even stronger; Adds one more step on top of an already high level. Written 更に but often kana; do not confuse with 再び meaning again

ja: 気配[けはい]を**感知[かんち]**した
en: I detected a presence; Sensor-like pickup of something at a distance — a skill readout word. A person's gut feeling is 感じる

ja: **周囲[しゅうい]**を警戒[けいかい]しろ
en: Watch the area around us; "Circumference" — the ring of space around a point or by extension the people nearby. Wider social environment is 環境

ja: **本来[ほんらい]**の力[ちから]じゃない
en: This is not his real power; Points to how something is by original nature versus its current state; often implies the present situation is a deviation

ja: 正体[しょうたい]を**隠[かく]して**いる
en: He is hiding his true identity; Transitive: you hide a thing. If you yourself hide then it is 隠れる. Concealing feelings takes 隠す too

ja: みんなに**迷惑[めいわく]**をかけた
en: I caused everyone trouble; 迷惑 is trouble inflicted on other people — the apology word. Your own difficulty is 大変 or 困る

ja: この話[はなし]に**乗[の]る**よ
en: I am in on this deal; Beyond boarding a vehicle 乗る takes に and means going along with an offer or a scheme

ja: その仕事[しごと]を**引[ひ]き受[う]けた**
en: I took the job on; "Pull" + "receive" — accepting a duty someone hands you along with the responsibility. Merely receiving an object is just 受ける

ja: 商人[しょうにん]と**取引[とりひき]**する
en: We will trade with the merchant; "Take" + "pull" — a two-way business deal. Also used for shady bargains between enemies

ja: **武装[ぶそう]**した兵士[へいし]だ
en: They are armed soldiers; "Weapon" + "equip" — being kitted out for battle and not the weapons themselves which are 武器

ja: **決[けっ]して**忘[わす]れないぞ
en: I will never forget it; 決して demands a negative later in the sentence; it strengthens the refusal rather than stating time

ja: 私[わたし]の**側[そば]**にいて
en: Stay by my side; そば is physical closeness within reach. The same kanji read がわ means a side or faction instead

ja: よく**働[はたら]いて**くれた
en: You worked hard for me; 働く is putting in labour; it needs no object. Something functioning or a skill activating also 働く

ja: 俺[おれ]が**最強[さいきょう]**だ
en: I am the strongest; 最 caps any adjective — here 強い. Boastful and absolute; a mere comparison uses もっと強い

ja: 俺[おれ]は父[ちち]に**似[に]て**いる
en: I take after my father; Almost always in the 似ている form — resemblance is a state rather than an action. Takes に for what is resembled

ja: **貴殿[きでん]**の実力[じつりょく]を認[みと]める
en: I acknowledge your ability; Stiff lordly "you" for letters and formal address between men of rank — respectful unlike the hostile 貴様 sharing that kanji

ja: 相手[あいて]の心[こころ]を**読[よ]む**
en: I read my opponent's mind; Beyond text 読む covers reading intentions or a situation — predicting the next move

ja: **大会[たいかい]**に参加[さんか]する
en: I will enter the tournament; "Big" + "meeting" — a large organised event and usually a contest. A business meeting is 会議

ja: **街道[かいどう]**で襲[おそ]われた
en: We were attacked on the highway; "Town" + "road" — the main road linking settlements and the classic bandit spot. An ordinary street is just 道

ja: **妾[わらわ]**は女王[じょおう]じゃ
en: I am the queen; Archaic first person for a highborn woman paired with old endings like じゃ. Modern speech never uses it

ja: **母[はは]**の料理[りょうり]が食[た]べたい
en: I want my mother's cooking; 母 is your own mother when talking to others; you call her お母さん to her face and use お母さん for someone else's

ja: **あんな**奴[やつ]に負[ま]けるな
en: Do not lose to someone like that; あんな points at something distant from both speakers and usually carries contempt; before a noun it never takes の

ja: **食事[しょくじ]**の用意[ようい]ができた
en: The meal is ready; "Eat" + "thing" — the occasion of eating so it pairs with する. The food itself is 料理

ja: 二人[ふたり]の気[き]が**合[あ]う**
en: Those two get along; 合う is two things matching each other with no actor; making them match is 合わせる. 気が合う is the set phrase for clicking

ja: 我[われ]が**守護[しゅご]**する
en: I shall be its guardian; Loftier than 守る — the standing duty of a guardian deity or sworn protector hence 守護者

ja: 住民[じゅうみん]を**解放[かいほう]**しろ
en: Free the residents; "Untie" + "let go" — releasing captives or lifting a seal. Political liberation too; 自由 is the resulting state

ja: **あまり**時間[じかん]がない
en: There is not much time; With a negative あまり means not very; with a positive it means excessively. Context decides which

ja: 村[むら]に**笑[わら]い声[ごえ]**が戻[もど]った
en: Laughter returned to the village; Compound of 笑う and 声 — the sound of laughing so it is heard not done. You cannot 笑い声する

ja: 頭[あたま]に**角[つの]**があるぞ
en: It has horns on its head; つの is an animal or demon horn. The same kanji read かく means a corner or an angle

ja: **星[ほし]**を見[み]よう
en: Let us look at the stars; Also a star mark or a famous person's fortune; 星が出る is how the show says the stars have come out

ja: **随分[ずいぶん]**楽[たの]しそうだな
en: You look like you are having quite a time; 随分 is a surprised "quite a lot" with a hint of that is more than expected. Flatter emphasis is とても

ja: 戦[たたか]いはまだ**続[つづ]く**
en: The battle still goes on; 続く happens by itself with no actor; if you keep doing something it is 続ける

ja: 後[あと]で**連絡[れんらく]**する
en: I will contact you later; "Connect" + "tie" — getting a message through rather than the conversation itself. Losing touch is 連絡が取れない

ja: この料理[りょうり]は**最高[さいこう]**だ
en: This food is the best; Literally highest; in speech it is a plain shout of delight rather than a ranking

ja: 子供[こども]が**泣[な]いて**いる
en: A child is crying; 泣く is weeping with tears; an animal's cry is 鳴く with the same reading

ja: 師匠[ししょう]に**褒[ほ]められた**
en: My master praised me; 褒める is a superior praising an inferior so being on the receiving end usually appears in the passive

ja: **腹[はら]**を刺[さ]された
en: He was stabbed in the belly; 腹 is the outer belly; the guts inside are 内臓. Figures of speech abound — 腹が立つ is to get angry

ja: 陛下[へいか]が**自[みずか]ら**来[き]た
en: His Majesty came in person; Adverb: the important party did it themselves rather than sending someone. Not the reflexive noun 自分

ja: 作戦[さくせん]を**開始[かいし]**する
en: We are commencing the operation; Formal declaration word for a start; 始める is what people say in daily speech

ja: **立派[りっぱ]**な騎士[きし]だな
en: He is a fine knight; 立派 praises impressive substance — bearing achievement or a building. 偉い judges a person's greatness or rank

ja: 魔物[まもの]の**住処[すみか]**を探[さが]す
en: We search for the monster's lair; From 住む — the den of a beast or an outlaw and never a respectable human home which is 家

ja: 剣[けん]を**抜[ぬ]け**
en: Draw your sword; 抜く is pulling something out of what holds it — a sword a tooth or a weed. Also outstripping a rival

ja: **西側[にしがわ]**は危険[きけん]だ
en: The west side is dangerous; 側 alone is just "side" — 西側 names one flank of a territory or building; for compass directions of a region the show prefers 西方

ja: お前[まえ]は**まだまだ**弱[よわ]い
en: You are still nowhere near strong enough; doubling まだ turns "not yet" into a gap that is still wide — it judges distance from the goal rather than mere timing

ja: **魔導[まどう]**の技術[ぎじゅつ]が凄[すご]い
en: Their magical arts are amazing; 魔法 is a spell you cast while 魔導 is the discipline and craft behind it — hence 魔導書 and 魔導兵器

ja: **開国[かいこく]**の準備[じゅんび]をしよう
en: Let us prepare to open the country; literally "open" + "country" — it covers both founding a nation and ending its isolation; here Tempest going public

ja: 俺[おれ]は**転生[てんせい]**した
en: I was reincarnated; "turn" + "life" — rebirth as a different being carrying your memories; 復活 by contrast is coming back as your old self

ja: 体[からだ]の**状態[じょうたい]**を確認[かくにん]する
en: I check my body's condition; a factual snapshot of how something is right now; 状況 is the wider situation around you

ja: その**条件[じょうけん]**は飲[の]めない
en: I cannot accept those terms; 条件 is a stipulation in a deal or a prerequisite — not a physical condition; 飲む is the idiom for swallowing terms

ja: 会議[かいぎ]の**際[さい]**に話[はな]す
en: I will bring it up at the meeting; stiffer written-style "on the occasion of" where speech would use 時 — expect it in reports and formal speeches

ja: お前[まえ]が**リーダー**だ
en: You are the leader; the loanword suits a squad or party head; a nation's ruler is 王 and a faction head is 盟主

ja: 俺[おれ]に何[なん]の**用[よう]**だ
en: What do you want with me; 用 is a piece of business needing your attention — 用がある means you are occupied by an errand

ja: 町[まち]を**案内[あんない]**しよう
en: Let me show you around town; "plan" + "inside" — leading someone through unfamiliar ground; also the word for a guide sign or an announcement

ja: この**都市[とし]**は大[おお]きいな
en: This city is big; 都市 is the administrative scale of a place while 町 is the lived-in town you walk around

ja: ドワーフの**職人[しょくにん]**に頼[たの]む
en: I will ask a dwarven craftsman; 職人 is a hands-on maker with trained skill; 商人 sells what the 職人 builds

ja: 洞窟[どうくつ]の**奥[おく]**に行[い]く
en: We are going deep into the cave; 奥 is the far inside measured from the entrance; it also politely names someone's wife as 奥さん

ja: この件[けん]は**譲[ゆず]らない**
en: I will not give ground on this; 譲る is yielding something you had the right to keep — a seat or a point in an argument

ja: 魔法[まほう]の**研究[けんきゅう]**を続[つづ]ける
en: I will keep researching magic; sustained systematic study; 調査 is a one-off investigation to find facts

ja: 推測[すいそく]が**当[あ]たった**
en: My guess was right; 当たる is a hit landing — a blow connecting or a prediction proving correct; its transitive partner is 当てる

ja: 情報[じょうほう]を**集[あつ]めろ**
en: Gather information; 集める takes things or people you pull together; 集まる is the crowd doing the gathering itself

ja: 昔[むかし]の事[こと]を**思[おも]い出[だ]した**
en: I remembered something from long ago; literally "think" + "put out" — dragging a memory back up; 覚える is putting it in

ja: もっと**詳[くわ]しく**説明[せつめい]しろ
en: Explain it in more detail; describes information that is fine-grained and also a person who is well versed — 詳しい人 knows the subject inside out

ja: 我[われ]が**命[めい]じる**
en: I command it; formal top-down ordering used by rulers; the noun 命令 is the order itself and 頼む is asking as a favour

ja: 時間[じかん]の**無駄[むだ]**だ
en: This is a waste of time; 無駄 is effort that produced nothing; 無理 is a thing that cannot be done at all

ja: お前[まえ]は**ずるい**ぞ
en: You are playing dirty; a complaint about someone cheating or exploiting an unfair edge — kids and comrades throw it around lightly

ja: **金[かね]**が足[た]りない
en: We do not have enough money; read かね it means money in general; read きん it is the metal gold — coins are 金貨

ja: **連邦[れんぽう]**の盟主[めいしゅ]だ
en: He is the master of the federation; 連邦 is member states sharing one government; 同盟 is a looser pact leaving each side independent

ja: もう**我慢[がまん]**できない
en: I cannot put up with it any longer; enduring something unpleasant by holding yourself back — not toughness in battle but self-restraint

ja: **国交[こっこう]**を結[むす]びたい
en: I want to establish diplomatic relations; "country" + "exchange" — the formal state-to-state channel; personal 関係 it is not

ja: **奴隷[どれい]**を解放[かいほう]する
en: I am freeing the slaves; 奴隷 is owned property; the 奴 in it is the same rough word used to spit at a guy

ja: あの**少女[しょうじょ]**を助[たす]けた
en: I saved that girl; a written-register word for a pre-teen or teenage girl; in speech people say 女の子

ja: 向[む]こうへ**渡[わた]る**ぞ
en: We are crossing to the other side; 渡る is going over and across a span — a bridge or a stretch of water; 通る is merely passing through

ja: 影響[えいきょう]が村[むら]に**及[およ]んだ**
en: The effects reached the village; 及ぶ is something spreading out until it touches a further point — damage or blame extending rather than a person arriving

ja: ここは我[わ]が**領域[りょういき]**だ
en: This is my domain; 領域 is the sphere you control or the field you own; 場所 is just a spot on a map

ja: これが俺[おれ]の**運命[うんめい]**か
en: So this is my fate; "carry" + "life" — the course already laid out for you; heavier and more inevitable than a mere 予定

ja: **早速[さっそく]**始[はじ]めよう
en: Let us start right away; すぐ is neutral speed while 早速 carries eagerness to act on what just happened

ja: この森[もり]は**深[ふか]い**な
en: This forest is deep; covers physical depth and also intensity — 深い意味 is a profound meaning and 興味深い is deeply interesting

ja: 洞窟[どうくつ]が迷宮[めいきゅう]に**繋[つな]がっている**
en: The cave connects to the labyrinth; 繋がる is the intransitive link forming by itself; 繋ぐ is you tying the two ends together

ja: 攻撃[こうげき]を**避[さ]けた**
en: I dodged the attack; 避ける is steering clear of something before it lands; 逃げる is fleeing after it starts

ja: **雑魚[ざこ]**に用[よう]はない
en: I have no business with small fry; literally "miscellaneous fish" — a mook not worth naming; pure insult and never said of yourself except in mock humility

ja: 一人[ひとり]だけ**生[い]き残[のこ]った**
en: Only one survived; "live" + "remain" — outlasting the others who died; 助かる is being saved by outside help

ja: **礼[れい]**を言[い]わせてくれ
en: Let me thank you; one word covering the words of thanks; the bow itself and a gift in return — 失礼 is literally "lacking 礼"

ja: 仲間[なかま]に**加[くわ]えてくれ**
en: Let me join your group; 加える is adding one item into an existing set; 加わる is joining under your own steam

ja: **余[よ]**が魔王[まおう]だ
en: I am the demon lord; an archaic first person reserved for a monarch speaking down to subjects — grandiose even beyond 我

ja: **おいら**も行[い]くぜ
en: I am coming too; a rustic countrified 俺 — cheerful and unrefined; marks the speaker as a plain-talking villager type

ja: **人形[にんぎょう]**みたいに動[うご]く
en: It moves like a puppet; "person" + "shape" — dolls and marionettes alike; calling someone a 人形 means they act without a will of their own

ja: これを**差[さ]し上[あ]げます**
en: Please accept this; the humble form of あげる — you lower yourself to hand something up to a superior; never used for what you give an inferior

ja: 俺[おれ]の**負[ま]け**だ
en: This one's my loss; the noun made from 負ける — you concede defeat with it and its opposite pair is 勝ち

ja: **試合[しあい]**が始[はじ]まる
en: The match is starting; 試合 is a scheduled bout under rules; 戦い is real combat and 勝負 is any showdown where a winner is decided

ja: 俺[おれ]に**誓[ちか]え**
en: Swear it to me; a solemn vow before someone with authority; 約束 is an everyday promise you can renegotiate

ja: ポーションが**なくなった**
en: We are out of potions; stock running out or an object vanishing from where it was; as a euphemism it also means someone passed away

ja: **風[かぜ]**が強[つよ]い
en: The wind is strong; read かぜ it is wind and also a cold you catch; the same kanji is ふう in compounds like 風呂

ja: 俺[おれ]の話[はなし]を**無視[むし]した**な
en: You ignored what I said; 無視 is "nothing" + "look" — deliberately pretending not to notice. 無視する takes を: you ignore a person or a warning

ja: この町[まち]は**きれい**だな
en: This town is lovely; きれい covers both pretty and clean — a spotless room is きれい too. Despite ending in い it inflects as a na-adjective: きれいな町

ja: 料理[りょうり]が**得意[とくい]**なんだ
en: I'm good at cooking; 得意 is a skill you are confident in; うまい praises the result. It also means smug — 得意そうな顔 is a self-satisfied look

ja: 明日[あした]**起[お]こして**くれ
en: Wake me up tomorrow; 起こす is the transitive pair of 起きる — you wake someone else. Second sense: to cause a problem or an incident

ja: 仲間[なかま]を**巻[ま]き込[こ]む**な
en: Don't drag your comrades into this; literally "roll in" — dragging someone into trouble that was not theirs. Almost always negative

ja: また**喧嘩[けんか]**か
en: Another fight; 喧嘩 is a personal brawl or a quarrel between two people; 戦い and 戦争 are combat between forces

ja: 準備[じゅんび]は**順調[じゅんちょう]**です
en: Preparations are going smoothly; 順調 describes a process staying on track and not a person. Standard in reports: 順調に進む

ja: 全員[ぜんいん]**集[あつ]まれ**
en: Everyone gather up; 集まる is intransitive — people come together by themselves; 集める is you collecting them

ja: **大量[たいりょう]**の魔力[まりょく]だ
en: That's a huge amount of magical energy; 大量 counts stuff in bulk; 多い just says numerous. Use 大量の before the noun

ja: この**空間[くうかん]**は何[なん]だ
en: What is this space; 空間 is empty three-dimensional space; 所 and 場所 are places you can name. The show uses it for pocket dimensions

ja: 一人[ひとり]も**残[のこ]す**な
en: Don't leave a single one; 残す is transitive — you leave something behind while 残る is it remaining on its own. Also used for leaving food uneaten

ja: 先[さき]へ**進[すす]もう**
en: Let's press on ahead; 進む is forward movement or progress; 行く is just going. Takes へ or を for the path

ja: 俺[おれ]が**対応[たいおう]する**
en: I'll handle it; 対応 is responding to a situation as it comes — dealing with a problem or a customer rather than a planned 準備

ja: **邪悪[じゃあく]**な気配[けはい]だ
en: An evil presence; 邪悪 is heavy literary evil about a being's nature; 悪い is everyday bad. Rare in casual speech

ja: お前[まえ]が**黒幕[くろまく]**か
en: So you're the one behind it; literally "black curtain" — the stagehand behind kabuki scenery so it means the hidden schemer nobody sees

ja: 勇者[ゆうしゃ]が**現[あらわ]れた**
en: A hero has appeared; 現れる is something hidden becoming visible; 出る is merely exiting. Used for dramatic entrances

ja: **卑怯[ひきょう]**な真似[まね]をするな
en: Don't fight dirty; 卑怯 accuses someone of unfair tactics or cowardice — a shout rather than a description. Fighting words in this show

ja: **地下[ちか]**に迷宮[めいきゅう]がある
en: There's a labyrinth underground; 地下 is "earth" + "under" — below ground level including basements; 下 alone is any lower position

ja: 違[ちが]う**種[しゅ]**の魔物[まもの]だ
en: It's a different species of monster; 種 read しゅ is a biological species; 種族 is the race as a people. Also counts kinds: 二種

ja: 町[まち]で**暴[あば]れる**な
en: Don't go on a rampage in town; 暴れる is thrashing and destroying without control; 怒る is just being angry. 暴走 shares the same kanji

ja: **ああ**構[かま]わない
en: Yeah that's fine; ああ points at a manner — "like that" — the pair of こう; a drawn-out ああ is also plain agreement

ja: **おとなしく**待[ま]ってろ
en: Sit tight and behave; おとなしい is docile and giving no trouble; 静か is merely quiet. Often aimed at children and prisoners

ja: そこが**重要[じゅうよう]**なんだ
en: That's the important part; 重要 is objective significance in a matter; 大切 is what you personally treasure. 必要 is needed rather than weighty

ja: **人類[じんるい]**の敵[てき]になる
en: We'll become enemies of humanity; 人類 is the human species as a whole; 人間 is a human as opposed to a monster; 人 is a person

ja: お前[まえ]は**優[やさ]しい**な
en: You're a kind one; 優しい is gentleness in how you treat others — also gentle on the eyes or the body; いい人 is broader approval

ja: **学園[がくえん]**の生徒[せいと]だ
en: They're academy students; 学園 is a private school complex with a grand name; 学校 is the neutral word. Signals a prestigious institution

ja: もう**到着[とうちゃく]した**のか
en: You've arrived already; 到着 is the formal noun for an arrival — announcements and reports; 来る and 帰る are what you say in conversation

ja: 奥[おく]に**光[ひかり]**が見[み]える
en: I see light deep inside; 光 is light as a thing you see; 光る is the verb to shine. Read ひかり as a noun; コウ in compounds

ja: 力[ちから]が**覚醒[かくせい]した**
en: My power has awakened; 覚醒 is "wake" + "clear" — sober literal waking; in this show it is the moment a latent power activates. 起きる is getting out of bed

ja: **平和[へいわ]**が一番[いちばん]だ
en: Peace is what matters most; 平和 is the state of no war between groups; 安心 is personal peace of mind; 安全 is being free of danger

ja: **一応[いちおう]**確認[かくにん]しておく
en: I'll check just to be safe; 一応 hedges — enough for now and not thoroughly. It also means "just in case" before a precaution

ja: **体内[たいない]**の魔力[まりょく]を感[かん]じる
en: I can feel the magic inside the body; 体内 is "body" + "inside" — an anatomical inside; 中 is any generic inside. Common in explanations of skills

ja: **ゲーム**じゃないんだぞ
en: This isn't a game; ゲーム means a video or board game and never a sports match — that is 試合. Rebuking someone for treating danger lightly

ja: 一人[ひとり]は**寂[さび]しい**な
en: Being alone is lonely; 寂しい covers both a lonely person and a desolate place — an empty street is 寂しい too. It is the ache of something missing not fear

ja: 俺[おれ]は力[ちから]を**求[もと]めた**
en: I sought power; 求める is actively seeking or demanding what you need; 探す is searching for a physical thing; 欲しい is only wanting

ja: **夜[よる]**まで待[ま]て
en: Wait until night; 夜 is the night hours as a period; 今夜 is tonight. 夕方 is the earlier evening. Read よる standing alone

ja: **昨日[きのう]**の話[はなし]だ
en: That was yesterday's business; 昨日 has the irregular reading きのう; the formal さくじつ appears in writing. 明日 and 今日 form the set

ja: 敵[てき]が**増[ふ]えて**きた
en: The enemies are multiplying; 増える is intransitive — numbers rise on their own; 増やす is you increasing them; 増す is a literary rise in degree

ja: **無茶[むちゃ]**をするな
en: Don't do anything reckless; 無茶 is action with no regard for sense or limits; 危険 describes the danger itself. 無茶苦茶 intensifies it to a total mess

ja: その依頼[いらい]は**断[ことわ]る**
en: I'm turning down that request; 断る refuses an offer or a request; やめる is quitting something already underway. The same kanji means to cut off

ja: それが**正解[せいかい]**だ
en: That's the right answer; 正解 is the one correct answer to a question or puzzle; 正しい is generally right. Also praises a good decision

ja: 生徒[せいと]の**指導[しどう]**を頼[たの]む
en: I'll leave the students' instruction to you; 指導 is "point" + "lead" — a senior guiding growth over time; 教える is just telling

ja: 頭[あたま]を**叩[たた]かれた**
en: I got smacked on the head; 叩く is striking with a hand or a flat blow — also knocking on a door; 打つ is a sharper impact; 殴る is a punch

ja: **若[わか]い**のに凄[すご]いな
en: Impressive for someone so young; 若い is young in years or immature in judgment. For a small child use 小さい. 新しい is for things

ja: **ちなみに**それは嘘[うそ]だ
en: By the way that's a lie; ちなみに adds a related side fact you just thought of; ところで switches the topic outright

ja: 何[なん]と**おっしゃいました**か
en: What did you say sir; おっしゃる is the honorific for 言う — for the other person's speech only. Your own humble form is 申す

ja: 俺[おれ]を**疑[うたが]う**のか
en: You doubt me; 疑う accuses — you suspect a person or a claim of being false; 信[しん]じない is merely failing to believe with no accusation in it

ja: **都合[つごう]**が悪[わる]いか
en: Is it a bad time; 都合 is how circumstances suit you — schedule or convenience or funds. 都合がいい about a person means self-serving

ja: 手[て]を**引[ひ]け**
en: Back off; 引く is pulling toward you — opposite of 押す. 手を引く idiomatically means withdrawing from an affair. Also drawing a card or catching a cold

ja: 俺[おれ]たちは**味方[みかた]**だ
en: We're on your side; 味方 is the opposite of 敵 — anyone in your camp in a fight; 仲間 is a companion you share a group with

ja: 会[あ]えて**光栄[こうえい]**です
en: It is an honor to meet you; 光[こう] light plus 栄[えい] glory: the honor felt at being praised or chosen; a reaction to how you are treated and never plain happiness

ja: **全力[ぜんりょく]**で戦[たたか]う
en: I will fight with everything I have; 全 all plus 力 strength; lives in the adverbial 全力で and in 全力を出す; it is effort poured out at maximum not natural talent

ja: **道化[どうけ]**の真似[まね]はやめろ
en: Quit playing the fool; 化 is transform: one who turns himself into a fool for an audience; thrown as an insult at someone clowning during a serious moment

ja: その**点[てん]**は問題[もんだい]ない
en: On that point there is no problem; one word for a dot on paper; a score in a match and an aspect of an argument; also the counter for points as in 三点

ja: ここは**神聖[しんせい]**な場所[ばしょ]だ
en: This is a sacred place; 神 god plus 聖 saint; a na-adjective for places and rites protected by the Church; it never describes a kind person

ja: 大会[たいかい]を**開催[かいさい]**する
en: We will hold a tournament; 開 open plus 催 stage; only for events such as tournaments and festivals; a door or a book uses 開く instead

ja: **証拠[しょうこ]**はあるのか
en: Do you have proof; 証 proof plus 拠 grounds; hard factual evidence you can produce; 理由 is the reasoning behind an act and not the thing that proves it

ja: **ランク**が高[たか]い魔物[まもの]だ
en: That monster is high rank; the guild grades adventurers and monsters into labelled tiers by this word; 上位 says something sits above others while ランク names the tier

ja: **選手[せんしゅ]**が集[あつ]まった
en: The contestants have gathered; 選 chosen plus 手 hand as person: one picked to compete; used of tournament fighters and never of a soldier in a 部隊

ja: 王[おう]の**使[つか]い**が来[き]た
en: A messenger from the king has come; the noun from 使う; it covers both the errand and the person running it; an envoy carrying words rather than a servant like 部下

ja: 口[くち]を**開[ひら]いた**
en: He opened his mouth; 開[ひら]く is for what unfolds or spreads such as a mouth a book or a meeting; the same kanji reads あく when the thing opens on its own

ja: 二人[ふたり]が**同時[どうじ]**に動[うご]いた
en: The two of them moved at the same time; 同 same plus 時 time; it appears almost only as the adverb 同時に; for at the same time as X say Xと同時に

ja: 提案[ていあん]を**検討[けんとう]**する
en: We will consider the proposal; 検 examine plus 討 debate; weighing a concrete plan and not idle musing; in negotiation it is a polite way to stall without agreeing

ja: 町[まち]が**破壊[はかい]**された
en: The town was destroyed; 破 break plus 壊 collapse; the physical wrecking of a thing or place; 滅ぼす is wiping out a people or a nation

ja: この草[くさ]には**毒[どく]**がある
en: This grass is poisonous; one word for poison venom and toxin; 毒がある also describes a barbed remark; it pairs with 耐性 for poison resistance

ja: わしの**息子[むすこ]**だ
en: He is my son; 息 breath plus 子 child; plain when speaking of your own; add さん for someone else's; the female counterpart is 娘

ja: **念[ねん]**のため確認[かくにん]する
en: I will check just in case; a focused thought or care directed at something; it rarely stands alone and mostly appears in 念のため; the verb 念じる is to will something

ja: 作戦[さくせん]を**変[か]えよう**
en: Let us change the plan; the transitive partner of 変[か]わる; you change something else with it; the homophone 帰る is to go home and 直す is to repair rather than swap

ja: 危険[きけん]な**人物[じんぶつ]**だ
en: He is a dangerous individual; 人 person plus 物; a person viewed as a character being sized up so it belongs in reports and assessments; colder and more distant than 人

ja: この**野郎[やろう]**待[ま]て
en: Hold it you bastard; literally field fellow; a curse aimed at men only and この野郎 starts fights; 奴 is merely rough beside it

ja: 先生[せんせい]が**いらっしゃった**
en: The teacher has arrived; one honorific covering いる 来る and 行く at once so context decides which; いらっしゃいませ greets customers; never use it of yourself

ja: 約束[やくそく]を**果[は]たした**
en: I kept my promise; to carry a duty or vow through to the end so it needs an object such as 役 or 約束; as an adverb 果たして means sure enough or I wonder

ja: **知恵[ちえ]**が必要[ひつよう]だ
en: We need some cleverness; practical wit for getting out of a fix rather than stored book learning; 知恵を貸す is to lend someone your brains

ja: これを**ご覧[らん]**ください
en: Please take a look at this; the honorific noun standing in for 見る; ご覧ください invites a superior to look while 〜てご覧 is a gentle try it said to children

ja: **肉体[にくたい]**を失[うしな]った
en: He lost his physical body; 肉 flesh plus 体 body; the flesh as the counterpart of 魂 the soul; 体 is neutral and 肉体 appears when spirit is the contrast

ja: 交渉[こうしょう]に**応[おう]じよう**
en: I will agree to negotiate; to answer a request or challenge by accepting it and it takes に; 〜に応じて means varying according to something

ja: 力[ちから]に**目覚[めざ]めた**
en: He awakened to his power; 目 eye plus 覚 wake; waking from sleep but far more often figurative for a power stirring; 起きる is the plain act of getting up

ja: 俺[おれ]**自身[じしん]**が行[い]く
en: I will go myself; attached behind a pronoun or a name for emphasis as in 私自身; 自分 stands on its own as oneself while 自身 leans on the noun before it

ja: 判断[はんだん]が**下[くだ]った**
en: The verdict has come down; intransitive descent used for orders judgments and sentences handed down from above; 落ちる is an uncontrolled fall

ja: **先[さき]ほど**の話[はなし]ですが
en: About what you said a moment ago; the polite twin of さっき; 先 ahead plus ほど extent; it points inside the current conversation so minutes not hours

ja: **ふざける**のはやめろ
en: Stop messing around; to act unserious or horse around; ふざけるな is a hard don't screw with me; telling an actual joke is 冗談を言う

ja: **せいぜい**二人[ふたり]だろう
en: Two of them at most; it caps an estimate dismissively as no more than that; said of effort as せいぜい頑張れ it turns sarcastic

ja: この金貨[きんか]を**渡[わた]して**くれ
en: Hand this gold coin over; the transitive mate of 渡る to cross: you pass an object across to someone; 与える grants from above while this is neutral delivery

ja: 王[おう]に**ふさわしい**男[おとこ]だ
en: He is a man worthy of being king; worthy of or matching a role and it takes に; it praises suitability for a position rather than raw skill

ja: **とんでもない**話[はなし]だ
en: That is an outrageous story; wildly off the mark or outrageous; alone as a reply to thanks or praise it becomes not at all; heavier than ひどい

ja: こいつが**本物[ほんもの]**の魔王[まおう]か
en: So this is the real demon lord; 本 true plus 物 thing; the genuine article set against a fake or a 真似; 真 is a loftier true reserved for titles

ja: もう一[いっ]**回[かい]**言[い]え
en: Say it one more time; the counter for repetitions of an act; 度 overlaps but 回 counts discrete tries while 度 leans toward occasions; 今回 is built on it

ja: **めでたい**日[ひ]だな
en: What a joyous day; for occasions worth celebrating such as a wedding or a victory; おめでとう is its greeting form; calling a person おめでたい means naive

ja: **おぬし**は何者[なにもの]だ
en: Who are you; an archaic you from お主 used by swordsmen and old sages toward an equal or a lesser; modern speech reaches for お前

ja: **日記[にっき]**を読[よ]むな
en: Don't read my diary; 日 day plus 記 record — the book itself. Keeping one is 日記をつける while 書[か]く refers to writing a single entry

ja: **部隊[ぶたい]**が到着[とうちゃく]した
en: The unit has arrived; 部 division plus 隊 troop; a named formation smaller than a 軍; 軍勢 is the whole mass of troops on the move

ja: **法皇[ほうおう]**に会[あ]いたい
en: I want to meet the pontiff; 法 doctrine plus 皇 emperor; the head of the Western Church who rules as a monarch in his own right unlike a 国王

ja: **素直[すなお]**に答[こた]えろ
en: Answer me straight; unguarded and compliant: saying what you feel without twisting it; praise for a child and a jab at an adult; 正直 is factual honesty instead

ja: 魔法[まほう]が**無効[むこう]**になった
en: The magic was nullified; 無 not plus 効 effect so it cancels what 効く grants; used of spells rules and contracts losing force

ja: そんなに**慌[あわ]てる**な
en: Don't panic like that; flustered rushing rather than fear; 慌てるな tells someone to slow down and settle not to be brave

ja: **胃袋[いぶくろ]**に入[はい]った
en: It went into my stomach; 胃 stomach plus 袋 bag; the organ as a container so it stands for how much you can put away; 腹 is the outer belly

ja: この**薬[くすり]**が効[き]く
en: This medicine works; any drug or remedy and ポーション is this world's version; Japanese 飲む medicine even when it is a powder or a pill

ja: 腹[はら]が**いっぱい**だ
en: I am full; from 一杯 meaning one cupful; it swings between a lot of something and filled to the brim; 全部 stresses completeness while this stresses quantity

ja: **異常[いじょう]**はないか
en: Anything abnormal to report; 異 different plus 常 normal; the standard word in a status check for anything off; in speech it collides with 以上 meaning more than

ja: **強力[きょうりょく]**な魔法[まほう]だ
en: That is powerful magic; a na-adjective for the force a thing or spell packs; 強い describes a fighter instead; it sounds identical to 協力 cooperation

ja: 町[まち]の**周辺[しゅうへん]**は安全[あんぜん]だ
en: The area around the town is safe; 周 is circumference and 辺 is edge — it names the ring of land around a point you name first with の

ja: みんなで**移動[いどう]**しよう
en: Let's all move out; 移 shift plus 動 move — relocating a body or unit to another place; never a political "movement"

ja: 話[はなし]が**逆[ぎゃく]**だぞ
en: You have got it backwards; means reversed direction or the other way round; 逆に at the head of a clause flips into "on the contrary"

ja: これで**十分[じゅうぶん]**だ
en: This is enough; the kanji read literally as "ten parts" — a full measure; the same two kanji read じっぷん mean ten minutes

ja: 師匠[ししょう]は**厳[きび]しい**な
en: Master is strict; used both for demanding people and for punishing conditions — 怖い is what frightens you while 厳[きび]しい makes no allowances

ja: いい**選択[せんたく]**だった
en: That was a good choice; 選 choose plus 択 pick — the deliberate act of taking one option from a set; stiffer than plain 選ぶ

ja: **集団[しゅうだん]**で襲[おそ]ってきた
en: They attacked as a pack; 集 gather plus 団 body — a mass moving together with no command structure unlike 軍

ja: お前[まえ]の**勘違[かんちが]い**だ
en: You have got the wrong idea; 勘 is gut instinct so this is a wrong conclusion you reached yourself; 間違[まちが]い is a plain mistake in fact

ja: 成功[せいこう]は何[なん]**パーセント**だ
en: What are the odds of success; the loanword is the precise technical option since native 割 counts only in tenths

ja: **急[きゅう]**な話[はなし]で悪[わる]いな
en: Sorry for the sudden request; same kanji as hurrying — as a na-adjective it is abruptness or urgency and 急に means all at once

ja: **酒[さけ]**を飲[の]もう
en: Let's have a drink; covers every alcoholic drink not just rice wine — the specific brew is 日本酒

ja: 仲間[なかま]を**裏切[うらぎ]った**のか
en: Did you betray your own comrades; 裏 back plus 切る cut — cutting at someone from behind them

ja: 強[つよ]い**けど**負[ま]けた
en: He is strong but he lost; the casual joiner for contrast — softer than しかし and often left hanging at the end of a sentence to hedge

ja: 住民[じゅうみん]を**避難[ひなん]**させろ
en: Get the residents to safety; 避 avoid plus 難 calamity — an organized move out of danger rather than 逃[に]げる which is fleeing

ja: 剣[けん]を俺[おれ]に**向[む]ける**な
en: Do not point that sword at me; the transitive partner of 向[む]かう — you aim a thing at a target instead of going toward one

ja: **感情[かんじょう]**を出[だ]すな
en: Do not show your feelings; 感 feel plus 情 sentiment — the inner state as a thing you can control; 気持[きも]ち is everyday mood

ja: 力[ちから]を**制御[せいぎょ]**できない
en: I cannot control this power; the technical holding-in-check of a force or machine while 支配 is dominion over people

ja: ちょっと**手伝[てつだ]って**くれ
en: Give me a hand for a second; 手 hand plus 伝う — helping with a task in progress whereas 助[たす]ける is rescue from danger

ja: オークを**皆殺[みなごろ]し**にする
en: We will wipe out every last orc; 皆 everyone plus 殺し killing — a noun that almost always arrives as 皆殺しにする

ja: **中央[ちゅうおう]**に集[あつ]まれ
en: Gather at the center; 中 middle plus 央 core — the central point of a territory or organization while bare 中 only means inside

ja: 魔力[まりょく]が**減[へ]って**きた
en: My magicules are running low; intransitive — the amount drops on its own and you need 減[へ]らす to say someone cut it

ja: **自信[じしん]**があるのか
en: Are you that confident; 自 self plus 信 trust so it is faith in your own ability; identical in sound to 地震 an earthquake

ja: **本日[ほんじつ]**の会議[かいぎ]は終[お]わりだ
en: Today's meeting is over; the formal reading of "this day" used in announcements and by attendants — 今日 in the same sentence would sound sloppy

ja: 新[あら]たな魔王[まおう]の**誕生[たんじょう]**だ
en: A new demon lord is born; 誕 plus 生 — grand enough for the debut of a nation or an era not only a baby

ja: 力[ちから]の**違[ちが]い**が分[わ]かるか
en: Can you feel the gap in our power; the noun made from 違[ちが]う — a difference between two things while 間違[まちが]い with the same kanji is an error

ja: 軍[ぐん]を**率[ひき]いる**のは俺[おれ]だ
en: I am the one leading the army; irregular reading of the kanji you meet in percentages — strictly commanding troops or a group not guiding a person

ja: みんなの**希望[きぼう]**になれ
en: Become everyone's hope; 希 scarce plus 望 wish — also the word for your stated preference on a form; 願[ねが]い is a wish put to someone else

ja: お前[まえ]は**優秀[ゆうしゅう]**だな
en: You are talented; praise for measurable ability or results of a person or unit whereas 素晴[すば]らしい is a gut reaction of awe

ja: そいつを**殴[なぐ]って**やる
en: I am going to punch that guy; specifically a fist blow — 叩[たた]く is lighter slapping or knocking

ja: これは**秘密[ひみつ]**だぞ
en: This stays a secret; 秘 conceal plus 密 dense — 秘書 a secretary is literally the one who keeps the hidden writings

ja: **全然[ぜんぜん]**怖[こわ]くない
en: Not scared in the slightest; careful speech pairs it with a negative but casual speakers also stack it on positives to mean totally

ja: **勉強[べんきょう]**になったよ
en: That was educational; literally forced effort — used for lessons learned from experience and by shopkeepers to mean knocking the price down

ja: **恐[おそ]ろしい**力[ちから]だ
en: What a terrifying power; describes the thing that inspires dread while 怖[こわ]い usually reports the speaker's own fear

ja: 宴[うたげ]に**招待[しょうたい]**したい
en: I want to invite you to the banquet; 招 beckon plus 待 receive — the host's formal invitation and never a casual "come along"

ja: **夏[なつ]**の祭[まつ]りだ
en: It is the summer festival; one of the four season words and on its own 夏だ announces that summer has arrived

ja: **獣人[じゅうじん]**の国[くに]へ行[い]く
en: We are going to the beastmen's nation; 獣 beast plus 人 — a distinct race with animal traits not a human who transforms

ja: 俺[おれ]に**挑戦[ちょうせん]**する気[き]か
en: So you mean to challenge me; 挑 provoke plus 戦 fight — always from the challenger's side taking on an opponent or a hard attempt

ja: **賠償[ばいしょう]**の話[はなし]をしよう
en: Let's talk compensation; 償 is making amends so this is legal payment for damage inflicted — what Rimuru demands of the kingdom that attacked

ja: **閃光[せんこう]**で目[め]が見[み]えない
en: The flash has blinded me; 閃 flicker plus 光 — a single instantaneous burst whereas steady light is just 光

ja: これが俺[おれ]の新[あたら]しい**人生[じんせい]**だ
en: This is my new life; the whole span and course of a human life while 命 is the vital force you can lose in a fight

ja: あの店[みせ]は**有名[ゆうめい]**だ
en: That shop is famous; literally "has a name" — it is a na-adjective so 有名な人 before a noun

ja: **変[へん]**な奴[やつ]だ
en: What a weird guy; built on the kanji of 変[か]わる so it frames oddness as a deviation from normal — 変な人 is a creep not a changed person

ja: **意外[いがい]**な結果[けっか]だった
en: The result was unexpected; 意 expectation plus 外 outside; 以外 sounds exactly the same but means everything except

ja: 調査[ちょうさ]の**対象[たいしょう]**は誰[だれ]だ
en: Who is the subject of the investigation; the neutral thing an action is aimed at — a 敵 is hostile but a 対象 is just in scope

ja: 魔物[まもの]が**たくさん**いるぞ
en: There are loads of monsters; a plain count of many things while いっぱい pictures a container filled to the brim and sounds more offhand

ja: ドワーフに**鉱石[こうせき]**を売[う]る
en: We sell ore to the dwarves; 鉱 mineral plus 石 stone — unrefined rock as raw material and magic ore is what Dwargon runs on

ja: 神[かみ]の**加護[かご]**があるはずだ
en: There should be divine protection; 加 grant plus 護 guard — bestowed only by gods or higher beings unlike 守護 which any guard performs

ja: **忠誠[ちゅうせい]**を誓[ちか]う
en: I swear my loyalty; sworn allegiance from a retainer to a lord — 信用 is the everyday trust between equals

ja: みんなで仲良[なかよ]く**暮[く]らす**
en: We all live together peacefully; means to pass your days and make a living whereas 生[い]きる is merely being alive and 住[す]む is only where you reside

ja: **兄貴[あにき]**と呼[よ]んでくれ
en: Call me big bro; rough affectionate address for an older brother or a senior in the gang — plain 兄 has none of that swagger

ja: **後悔[こうかい]**はしない
en: I have no regrets; 後悔 is "after" + "repent" — regret felt looking back at your own choice; it does not mean apologising to someone

ja: **今年[ことし]**の祭[まつ]りは凄[すご]い
en: This year's festival is amazing; 今年 is read ことし not こんねん — an irregular reading; the 今〜 series gives 今日 きょう and 今年 ことし

ja: 魔物[まもの]に**関[かん]する**報告[ほうこく]だ
en: This is a report on the monsters; 関する only appears as 〜に関する before a noun or 〜に関して mid-sentence; it is stiff written-style where speech would just use の

ja: **ごめん**な 待[ま]たせた
en: Sorry to keep you waiting; ごめん is casual apology between equals; 申し訳ない or すみません upward — ごめんなさい to a superior sounds childish

ja: **爆炎[ばくえん]**の魔法[まほう]だ
en: It is explosive-flame magic; 爆炎 is "burst" + "flame" — a coined attack-name compound; the show uses it for named techniques rather than an ordinary fire

ja: **ちょうど**いい時[とき]だ
en: You came at just the right moment; ちょうど pins a thing exactly on a point — time amount or size; not "just now" in the sense of a moment ago

ja: お前[まえ]の**活躍[かつやく]**を期待[きたい]する
en: I expect great things from you; 活躍 is visible achievement that others notice; 頑張る is the effort you put in yourself

ja: **一気[いっき]**に飲[の]め
en: Down it in one; 一気に means without pause or interruption — used for drinking chugging and for finishing a job in one push

ja: **突然[とつぜん]**現[あらわ]れたな
en: You showed up out of nowhere; 突然 is abrupt and usually unwelcome; 急に is softer everyday suddenness

ja: **まさに**最強[さいきょう]だ
en: Truly the strongest; まさに is emphatic confirmation that a label fits perfectly; まさか is the opposite — disbelief

ja: 俺[おれ]が大[おお]きな事[こと]を**成[な]す**
en: I'm the one who will accomplish something great; 成す is literary "bring into being"; ordinary speech uses する or 作る — 成す survives mainly in set phrases

ja: **きちんと**説明[せつめい]しろ
en: Explain it properly; きちんと means tidily and to the required standard; しっかり is about firmness and vigour instead

ja: ただの**虫[むし]**じゃない
en: That is no ordinary insect; 虫 covers insects worms and bugs broadly and is also an insult for a contemptibly weak creature

ja: 敵[てき]の数[かず]に**驚[おどろ]いた**
en: I was shocked at how many enemies there were; 驚く is the involuntary jolt of surprise and takes に for its cause; 驚かす is to startle someone else

ja: 軍[ぐん]の**指揮[しき]**は任[まか]せる
en: I leave command of the army to you; 指揮 is the act of directing troops or an orchestra; 命令 is a single order issued

ja: **以前[いぜん]**会[あ]ったよな
en: We have met before haven't we; 以前 is an unspecified earlier time; 前 alone often means physically in front so 以前 disambiguates

ja: 村[むら]へ**転送[てんそう]**する
en: I'll teleport you to the village; 転送 is "transfer" + "send" — also the plain word for forwarding mail; the show uses it for magical relocation

ja: **漫画[まんが]**を読[よ]みたい
en: I want to read manga; 漫画 literally "rambling pictures" — covers any comic including foreign ones not just Japanese

ja: 大会[たいかい]で**優勝[ゆうしょう]**する
en: I'll win the tournament; 優勝 is taking first place overall; 勝つ is beating one opponent in one match

ja: **妖魔[ようま]**の気配[けはい]がする
en: I sense a monster; 妖魔 is an eerie supernatural apparition; 魔物 is the general game-style monster category

ja: **武闘[ぶとう]**大会[たいかい]が始[はじ]まる
en: The fighting tournament begins; 武闘 is armed or martial combat and appears almost only inside 武闘大会; 武道 ぶどう is the disciplines you train in

ja: **痛[いた]い**やめてくれ
en: That hurts stop; 痛い describes the pain not the thing causing it — the body part takes が; it also means painful to watch

ja: **エキストラ**スキルを得[え]た
en: I got an extra skill; エキストラ here is a power rank above ordinary skills; in everyday Japanese the word means a film background actor

ja: 魔力[まりょく]の**濃度[のうど]**が高[たか]い
en: The magic concentration is high; 濃度 is how thick or dense a mixture is — pairs with 高い低い not 多い少ない

ja: 結界[けっかい]に問題[もんだい]が**発生[はっせい]**した
en: A problem has arisen in the barrier; 発生 is something undesirable coming into existence by itself; 始まる needs a thing that starts

ja: **割[わり]**が悪[わる]い勝負[しょうぶ]だ
en: The odds are bad on this fight; 割 is a tenth so 三割 is thirty percent; 割がいい悪い means the ratio of payoff to risk

ja: その**発言[はつげん]**は許[ゆる]さない
en: I won't forgive that remark; 発言 is a statement made on the record in a meeting or public setting; 言葉 is words in general

ja: **この世[よ]**に神[かみ]はいない
en: There is no god in this world; この世 is the world of the living as opposed to あの世 the afterlife; 世界 is the physical world

ja: 法皇[ほうおう]が**呼[よ]び出[だ]した**
en: The pope has summoned you; 呼び出す is "call" + "put out" — calling someone away to where you are; 召喚 is magical summoning

ja: かわいい**女[おんな]の子[こ]**だな
en: She is a cute girl; 女の子 is a child or a young woman informally; 少女 is the written-style word and 女 alone is blunt

ja: もう**寝[ね]る**わ
en: I'm going to bed; 寝る is lying down or going to bed while 眠る is actually falling asleep — you can 寝る without 眠る

ja: この**味[あじ]**は最高[さいこう]だ
en: This tastes incredible; 味 is the flavour a thing has; the verb is 味がする not 味を感じる and 味わう is to savour

ja: お前[まえ]**次第[しだい]**だ
en: It's up to you; 次第 after a noun means depending on it; after a verb stem it means as soon as — 着き次第 the moment we arrive

ja: **外[そと]**は危険[きけん]だぞ
en: It's dangerous outside; 外 is outdoors or outside a boundary; 以外 is "other than" and 外れ is off-target — do not mix them

ja: 魔物[まもの]を**従[したが]えて**いる
en: He has monsters at his command; 従える is the transitive pair of 従う — you lead them and they obey; the retinue takes を

ja: 我[わ]が**友[とも]**よ
en: My friend; 友 is the grand literary form used in address; 友達 is the everyday word — 我が友 sounds like a speech

ja: **チーム**で戦[たたか]おう
en: Let's fight as a team; チーム is a formed unit with a purpose; 仲間 is the emotional bond of comrades regardless of structure

ja: 言葉[ことば]が**通[つう]じない**
en: We can't understand each other; 通じる is a message or route getting through; 分かる is comprehension on one side only

ja: **調子[ちょうし]**はどうだ
en: How are things going; 調子 is the current state of a body machine or run of luck; 調子に乗る is getting carried away

ja: **正式[せいしき]**な同盟[どうめい]を結[むす]ぶ
en: We form a formal alliance; 正式 is officially recognised procedure; 正しい is morally or factually correct — different axis

ja: **了解[りょうかい]**しました 旦那[だんな]
en: Understood boss; 了解 is acknowledging an instruction; to a real superior 承知しました is safer since 了解 can read as clipped

ja: **被害[ひがい]**は大[おお]きい
en: The damage is severe; 被害 is damage suffered from the victim's side; 破壊 is the act of destroying — 被害者 is the victim

ja: **隊長[たいちょう]**の命令[めいれい]だ
en: It's the captain's order; 隊長 is the head of a 隊 squad or unit; リーダー is informal and 首領 is a boss of bandits or a horde

ja: あいつは**怪[あや]しい**な
en: That guy is suspicious; 怪しい means dubious and not to be trusted; 疑う is the act of doubting done by a person

ja: **小[ちい]さい**子供[こども]がいる
en: There is a small child; 小さい is the adjective while 小さな only attaches before a noun; a young child is 小さい and 若[わか]い starts from teenagers

ja: 新[あたら]しい薬[くすり]を**開発[かいはつ]**した
en: We developed a new medicine; 開発 is deliberately building something new — products land software; 成長 is growth that happens

ja: **自然[しぜん]**の力[ちから]は強[つよ]い
en: The power of nature is strong; 自然 is both nature and "unforced" as an adjective; 不自然 means awkward or contrived

ja: 先[さき]に**仕掛[しか]ける**ぞ
en: We strike first; 仕掛ける is initiating something on an opponent — a trap a fight or an argument; 攻撃する is just to attack

ja: 町[まち]の**防衛[ぼうえい]**を頼[たの]む
en: I'm counting on you for the town's defence; 防衛 is military defence of territory; 守る is protecting anything and 守護 is guardianship

ja: まだ**諦[あきら]めない**
en: I'm not giving up yet; 諦める is releasing a hope you held; やめる is merely stopping an action and 負ける is losing

ja: 俺[おれ]の**答[こた]え**は変[か]わらない
en: My answer isn't changing; noun from 答[こた]える — an answer given or a solution to a problem; not a reply-as-action which stays a verb

ja: 相手[あいて]を**見極[みきわ]めろ**
en: Size up your opponent; 見る plus 極める — looking until you reach the limit; it means judging something's true nature not merely spotting it

ja: 人[ひと]の**形[かたち]**をしている
en: It has a human shape; the outward shape of a thing; 形 is visible contour while 姿[すがた] is how a whole figure appears

ja: 我[わ]が**怒[いか]り**を知[し]れ
en: Know my wrath; noun from 怒[おこ]る and much heavier than it — burning anger a demon lord announces not everyday annoyance

ja: お前[まえ]の**精神[せいしん]**は強[つよ]い
en: Your spirit is strong; mind and willpower as opposed to 体[からだ]; used for mental toughness never for a ghost

ja: 最強[さいきょう]を**目指[めざ]す**
en: I aim to be the strongest; eyes plus point — takes を for the goal aimed at; 向[む]かう is physically heading somewhere

ja: 俺[おれ]の**弟子[でし]**になれ
en: Become my disciple; the pupil side of 師匠[ししょう]; a live-in follower of a master not a school 生徒[せいと]

ja: その提案[ていあん]に**賛成[さんせい]**だ
en: I agree to that proposal; approve plus become — voting yes to a plan or motion; it takes に and its antonym 反対 is the word you will hear against it

ja: 武器[ぶき]を**扱[あつか]う**のがうまい
en: He is good at handling weapons; covers wielding a tool and treating a person a certain way; the sense is managing something correctly

ja: この剣[けん]に魂[たましい]が**宿[やど]る**
en: A soul dwells in this sword; intransitive — the thing that dwells takes が; used of spirits and power residing inside an object

ja: 迷宮[めいきゅう]**攻略[こうりゃく]**を始[はじ]める
en: We begin clearing the labyrinth; attack plus take — beating a dungeon or a puzzle; 攻撃[こうげき] is just striking with no completion implied

ja: お前[まえ]が**選[えら]べ**
en: You choose; picking from options in front of you; 決[き]める is settling a matter which may involve no choices at all

ja: **友好[ゆうこう]**を望[のぞ]む
en: We want friendly relations; friend plus like — between nations or groups; never say 友好 about your own two friends

ja: あの男[おとこ]は**司教[しきょう]**だ
en: That man is a bishop; a rank in the show's 聖教[せいきょう] church; 司 is to administer so it names an office not piety

ja: **天狗[てんぐ]**の里[さと]に行[い]く
en: We go to the tengu village; a mountain goblin of Japanese folklore with a long nose and wings; a native yokai not a Western monster

ja: 彼[かれ]は**聖人[せいじん]**と呼[よ]ばれる
en: He is called a saint; holy plus person — a title other people grant you; ranks above 賢者[けんじゃ] in reverence not in power

ja: **殿下[でんか]**お待[ま]ちください
en: Please wait Your Highness; address for a prince or princess; 陛下[へいか] is reserved for the king or queen themselves

ja: **自慢[じまん]**の部下[ぶか]だ
en: He is the subordinate I am proud of; 自慢の X means my prized X; standing alone the word means bragging and sounds childish

ja: **生命[せいめい]**の力[ちから]を感[かん]じる
en: I feel the force of life; life as a phenomenon; 命[いのち] is one individual's life that can be lost

ja: 戦[たたか]いに**備[そな]える**
en: Prepare for battle; に marks what you brace for; 準備[じゅんび]する is doing the tasks while 備える is standing ready for what may come

ja: この**辺[へん]**に巣[す]があるはずだ
en: The nest should be somewhere around here; used only after この or その or あの; a vague zone never an exact spot

ja: **あっさり**負[ま]けた
en: He lost without a fight; easily and plainly with no resistance; also describes light unfussy food

ja: **改[あら]めて**挨拶[あいさつ]する
en: Let me greet you properly; doing it over again and more formally; plain また is only a repeat with no ceremony

ja: **モンスター**が現[あらわ]れた
en: A monster appeared; the game-flavoured loanword the show uses for hostile creatures; 魔物[まもの] sounds older and more ominous

ja: 敵[てき]を**圧倒[あっとう]**した
en: We overwhelmed the enemy; press plus topple — winning by sheer margin; 圧倒的 describes the gap itself

ja: その言葉[ことば]は**ありがたい**
en: Those words mean a lot; an adjective for what you receive gratefully; the gift is ありがたい while a person says 感謝[かんしゃ]する

ja: 部下[ぶか]を**よこせ**
en: Send some men over; よこす is casual and directional — send it here to me; 渡[わた]す is handing over with no direction implied

ja: **予想[よそう]**通[どお]りだ
en: Just as expected; guess beforehand; 予想通り is a set phrase; 推測[すいそく] is reasoned inference not a hunch about an outcome

ja: 昔[むかし]と**比[くら]べる**な
en: Do not compare it with the past; と marks what you compare against; 比べて after a noun means compared to

ja: **襲撃[しゅうげき]**を受[う]けた
en: We came under attack; attack plus strike — one sudden raid; 襲[おそ]う is the verb and 戦争[せんそう] is the whole war

ja: 名[な]を**授[さず]ける**
en: I bestow a name upon you; granting downward — a lord to a vassal or a god to a mortal; 与[あた]える is neutral giving

ja: 魔力[まりょく]を体[からだ]に**回[まわ]す**
en: I circulate magic through my body; transitive — turning or routing something around; 回[まわ]る is the intransitive spin

ja: **イメージ**が大切[たいせつ]だ
en: The mental picture matters; the image you hold in your head; in Japanese it is what you imagine not your public reputation

ja: **気分[きぶん]**が悪[わる]い
en: I feel awful; your passing mood or bodily feeling; 気持[きも]ち can be a lasting sentiment toward someone

ja: **団長[だんちょう]**に報告[ほうこく]する
en: Report to the commander; head of a 団 — a knight order or a troupe; 隊長[たいちょう] leads a smaller unit in the field

ja: 新[あら]たな**発見[はっけん]**だ
en: That is a new discovery; emit plus see — finding what was already there; 発明[はつめい] would be inventing it

ja: **肉[にく]**が食[く]いたい
en: I want meat; meat as food and also flesh on a body; 肉体[にくたい] is the physical body

ja: **空[そら]**を見[み]ろ
en: Look at the sky; the sky overhead; the same kanji read から means empty so context decides

ja: 俺[おれ]の**出番[でばん]**だ
en: My turn; go out plus turn in order — your cue to step up; 番 alone is just a place in a queue

ja: 結界[けっかい]を**張[は]る**
en: Put up a barrier; stretching something taut across a space; used for barriers tents and nets

ja: この**辺[あた]り**に何[なに]かいる
en: Something is around here; 辺り attaches freely to places and times unlike the fixed この辺

ja: 敵[てき]は**去[さ]った**
en: The enemy has left; departing from a place for good; 帰[かえ]る is going back where you belong

ja: その**時点[じてん]**で気付[きづ]いた
en: I noticed at that moment; time plus point — a moment used as a reference marker; not a span like 時間[じかん]

ja: **凄[すさ]まじい**音[おと]がした
en: There was a tremendous noise; far heavier than 凄[すご]い and edged with dread; use it for destruction not for praise

ja: 俺[おれ]には**かなわない**
en: You are no match for me; almost always negative — cannot measure up; the identical-sounding かなう for wishes coming true is a different word

ja: **手段[しゅだん]**を選[えら]ぶな
en: Do not be picky about methods; hand plus step — a concrete means to an end; 方法[ほうほう] is neutral while 手段 hints at what you will stoop to

ja: ここが**戦場[せんじょう]**だ
en: This is the battlefield; the place where 戦[たたか]い happens; read せんじょう not いくさば in modern speech

ja: **茶[ちゃ]**でも飲[の]むか
en: Shall we have some tea; bare 茶 is blunt and masculine; お茶 is the normal polite form

ja: 仲間[なかま]に**手出[てだ]し**するな
en: Do not lay a hand on my friends; hand plus put out — interfering with or attacking someone; a threat-line word

ja: **ようやく**終[お]わった
en: It is finally over; finally after a long wait with relief; やっと is its casual twin and ついに is neutral narration
